\section[(dialogue)]{Food, clothes and animals — a first pass}

\label{lesson:FA-R127-first-pass-food-clothes-and-animals}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for purple and grey.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item beans, chickpeas, a coin, a bracelet, a tie
  \item a jacket, slippers, a pond, a spring, a salt desert
  \item a buffalo, a beetle, a worm, an insect, a giraffe
  \item a whale, a dolphin, a shark, a squirrel, a bat
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Beans? (\textbf{\fa{لوبیا}}, \emph{lubiyâ}.) Chickpeas? (\textbf{\fa{نخود}}, \emph{nokhod}.) A coin? (\textbf{\fa{سکه}}, \emph{sekke}.) A bracelet? (\textbf{\fa{دستبند}}, \emph{dastband}.) A tie? (\textbf{\fa{کراوات}}, \emph{kerâvât}.) A jacket? (\textbf{\fa{کاپشن}}, \emph{kâpshan}.) Slippers? (\textbf{\fa{دمپایی}}, \emph{dampâyi}.) A pond? (\textbf{\fa{برکه}}, \emph{barke}.) A spring? (\textbf{\fa{چشمه}}, \emph{cheshme}.) A salt desert? (\textbf{\fa{کویر}}, \emph{kavir}.) A buffalo? (\textbf{\fa{گاومیش}}, \emph{gâvmish}.) A beetle? (\textbf{\fa{سوسک}}, \emph{susk}.) A worm? (\textbf{\fa{کرم}}, \emph{kerm}.) An insect? (\textbf{\fa{حشره}}, \emph{hashare}.) A giraffe? (\textbf{\fa{زرافه}}, \emph{zarâfe}.) A whale? (\textbf{\fa{نهنگ}}, \emph{nahang}.) A dolphin? (\textbf{\fa{دلفین}}, \emph{delfin}.) A shark? (\textbf{\fa{کوسه}}, \emph{kuse}.) A squirrel? (\textbf{\fa{سنجاب}}, \emph{sanjâb}.) A bat? (\textbf{\fa{خفاش}}, \emph{khofâsh}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Describing words — a second pass}

\label{lesson:FA-R127-second-pass-describing-words}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for the forehead and a beard.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item the forehead, a beard, a moustache, long, wide
  \item narrow, deep, wet, dry, soft
  \item hard, ugly, young, old, lazy
  \item clever, timid, famous, dangerous, safe
  \item bitter, sour, salty, purple, grey
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
The forehead? (\textbf{\fa{پیشانی}}, \emph{pishâni}.) A beard? (\textbf{\fa{ریش}}, \emph{rish}.) A moustache? (\textbf{\fa{سبیل}}, \emph{sebil}.) Long? (\textbf{\fa{دراز}}, \emph{derâz}.) Wide? (\textbf{\fa{پهن}}, \emph{pahn}.) Narrow? (\textbf{\fa{باریک}}, \emph{bârik}.) Deep? (\textbf{\fa{گود}}, \emph{gowd}.) Wet? (\textbf{\fa{خیس}}, \emph{khis}.) Dry? (\textbf{\fa{خشک}}, \emph{khoshk}.) Soft? (\textbf{\fa{نرم}}, \emph{narm}.) Hard? (\textbf{\fa{سفت}}, \emph{seft}.) Ugly? (\textbf{\fa{زشت}}, \emph{zesht}.) Young? (\textbf{\fa{جوان}}, \emph{javân}.) Old? (\textbf{\fa{پیر}}, \emph{pir}.) Lazy? (\textbf{\fa{تنبل}}, \emph{tanbal}.) Clever? (\textbf{\fa{زرنگ}}, \emph{zerang}.) Timid? (\textbf{\fa{ترسو}}, \emph{tarsu}.) Famous? (\textbf{\fa{مشهور}}, \emph{mashhur}.) Dangerous? (\textbf{\fa{خطرناک}}, \emph{khatarnâk}.) Safe? (\textbf{\fa{امن}}, \emph{amn}.) Bitter? (\textbf{\fa{تلخ}}, \emph{talkh}.) Sour? (\textbf{\fa{ترش}}, \emph{torsh}.) Salty? (\textbf{\fa{شور}}, \emph{shur}.) Purple? (\textbf{\fa{بنفش}}, \emph{banafsh}.) Grey? (\textbf{\fa{خاکستری}}, \emph{khâkestari}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
